main.description: Open a Stripe Customer Portal session for the caller's account, and return the URL to send them to. Customers with a subscription only.

flow.description: paymentMethod: straight to adding or changing the card. manage: the Portal home, for invoices and cancelling.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID the client generates once per request and resends on every retry of it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: flow or idempotencyKey is missing or malformed, or the provisioner refused the request as malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InvalidSlug
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: SlugTaken
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NotEntitled
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: InstanceLimit
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: NoCapacity
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: AccountSuspended
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PlanNotOffered
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner.

errors.name: PaymentRequired
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: no subscription covers this. Start a Checkout (actor.createCheckout).

errors.name: CardRequired
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: a trial without a card covers one instance. Add a card (actor.createBillingPortal) for more.

errors.name: TrialPoolFull
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: every trial slot without a card is taken. A Checkout with payment "card" starts now; otherwise the caller joins the capacity queue.

errors.name: AccountOnHold
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: payments failed, and the account's instances stay stopped until the card is fixed.

errors.name: CheckoutIncomplete
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: Stripe hasn't finished the Checkout yet. Try again shortly.

errors.name: CheckoutExpired
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the Checkout was abandoned or expired. Start another.

errors.name: BillingUnavailable
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: billing is switched off.

errors.name: CodeInvalid
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: no such waitlist code.

errors.name: CodeUsed
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: that waitlist code has been used.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
